profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: .Net Developer that has 1 year of experience in the travel industry and 3 years of experience in the retail industry. I have worked closely with stake holders, business analysts, and product managers to ensure that new features get shipped and bugs get fixed. Finally, I have given a cross-team presentation on the benefits of Unit Testing with technologies and methods to use, and I worked with managers to see what worked best for their teams.
